intro: The Alessa unit makes small spaces feel bigger. Its tall, compact design & spacious shelves keep your favourite books & décor neatly arranged, while a modern finish elevates any corner of your home.

features.title: Sleek vertical design that saves space
features.text: Designed to fit into any corner, this tall display unit maximises storage without taking up extra floor space, making your room feel more open and organised.

features.title: Plenty of room for books and décor
features.text: With spacious shelves, you can easily display books, souvenirs, and decorative pieces—turning everyday items into part of your home’s personality.

features.title: Elegant glass doors for dust protection
features.text: Toughened glass doors not only enhance the aesthetics but also protect your belongings from dust, ensuring a clean and clear display every time.

features.title: Premium finishes that complement your home
features.text: A refined dual-tone finish brings a modern touch, matching effortlessly with different décors and adding a polished, sophisticated look to your space.

features.title: Easy to maintain for everyday convenience
features.text: Designed with durable materials, our unit resists stains and dust, making upkeep effortless so your shelves always look fresh and well-kept.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
